subject: DataBridge Systems: Marketplace listing & co-sell billing integration
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@databridge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@databridge.com
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-sell + listing: initial ask and contract draft

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for taking the intro call last week — excited about the potential to list DataBridge's MLOps suite in Redwood's marketplace and to pursue a co-sell arrangement. We pulled together an initial draft of the AWS SaaS contract and a short list of questions so we can scope the listing and approval work on our side.

High level asks:
- Confirmation of the billing model Redwood requires for co-sell eligible listings (seller-of-record vs. reseller flow).
- Metering SKU guidance for combined seats + inference tokens use cases.
- Any security evidence requirements beyond SOC2 snapshot and the standard marketplace forms.
- Timeline and who at Redwood will own technical evidence triage.

Attached: DataBridge_AWS_SaaS_Contract_draft.pdf (PDF)

Proposed timeline: target listing QA by end of April, co-sell enablement by mid-May.

Can you point me to the right people on the Redwood side to get the technical evidence and billing questions resolved? Also copied procurement for contract routing.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Partnerships | DataBridge Systems
[attachment: DataBridge_AWS_SaaS_Contract_draft.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@databridge.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2029 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Co-sell + listing: initial ask and contract draft

Elena — thanks for the note and the draft.

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood typically supports both models but prefers a reseller (marketplace-managed) flow for co-sell because it simplifies attribution and payout; we can discuss seller-of-record for select enterprise customers.
- Metering: we map "inference tokens" to a per-1000-token SKU and allow an add-on per-seat SKU. For hybrid pricing there is a standard pattern we can share.
- Evidence: SOC2 snapshot is the baseline; we will also need a short technical-runbook (deployment diagram, auth patterns, and network requirements) and a short telemetry sample for co-sell reporting (sample 7-day usage CSV).

Naomi is copied — she owns marketplace approvals and evidence. Ben will help with SKU mapping and billing integrations.

Next steps I propose:
1) Naomi: we'll run a 30-min intake with DataBridge to walk the evidence checklist.
2) Elena/DB: share the runbook and a sample usage CSV.
3) Ben + our billing team: quick sync to confirm SKU mapping and any contract language edits for the marketplace flow.

Can we aim for an intake call later this week? I'm available Thu 3/21 10:00-12:00 PDT or Fri 3/22 09:00-11:00 PDT.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Partnerships PM, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Marcus — great, thanks for the clarity. Thu 3/21 10:30 PDT works for us.

A few clarifications we ran with our legal and billing teams:
- We can provide the runbook and sample CSV by Wed 3/20 EOD.
- SOC2 snapshot attached (DBS_SOC2-snapshot-2028.pdf).
- We currently meter token usage server-side and can export a 7-day usage file; we are exploring whether to move to an RPC meter shim depending on Redwood's recommendation.
